Sara M.: Quick follow-up on the warmup RFC: I think we should expose per-layer cold_start_score so the coordinator can prioritize across multi-tenant workloads.
Liam: Can you sketch how the score is computed?
Sara M.: Basic idea: cold_start_score = a * expected_access_rate + b * memory_pressure + c * recompute_cost. We keep the weights tunable per-model. Coordinator sums layer scores and picks layers under budget.
Dmitri: That works in theory. Concern: telemetry burden if coordinator needs per-layer stats for many models.
Meera: Loader interface should stay minimal. Proposal: loader exposes SummarizeLayers(model_id, layer_ids) -> summaries with est_access_rate and est_size. Coordinator computes score.
Tony: Alternatively loaders compute and return layer_score + provenance blob. Reduces RPCs but needs loader upgrades.
warmup-bot: Reminder: keep warmup RPC p50 < 1ms to avoid SLO regressions. :warning:
Liam: Hybrid option: loaders return coarse per-chunk summaries; coordinator requests detail for top candidates.
Dmitri: Agree. Proto sketch: 
```proto
service WarmupService {
  rpc SummarizeLayers(SummarizeRequest) returns (SummarizeResponse);
  rpc LayerDetail(LayerDetailRequest) returns (LayerDetailResponse);
}
message SummarizeRequest { string model_id = 1; repeated uint32 layer_ids = 2; }
message SummarizeResponse { repeated LayerSummary summaries = 1; }
message LayerSummary { uint32 layer_id = 1; float est_access_rate = 2; uint64 est_size = 3; string variant_tag = 4; }
```
Meera: Include schema_version header and optional provenance so coordinator can fallback with older loaders.
Tony: For quantized variants, size and recompute cost differ; include variant multipliers in the summary.
Sara M.: Operation notes: sample summaries (1-5%) to reduce load; allow ramp for canaries. Coordinator should implement default fallback heuristics if detail requests time out: pick highest-parameter layers and apply prefix KV caching.
Liam: I'll run a quick perf probe on staging to measure SummarizeLayers latency at scale.
Dmitri: I'll add fallback metrics and a dashboard.
Meera: Who will draft the RFC PR? Keep it small, opt-in for loaders.
Sara M.: I'll open a PR tomorrow with proto, coordinator scoring pseudocode, and a sensitivity sim.
Tony: I'll add the variant multipliers table and review.
warmup-bot: Task created WARMUP-2130 (layer-score-summarize-rfc).
Sara M.: One stylistic note: avoid "prefetch bidding" in the writeup. Keep it technical. :smile:
Meera: :thumbsup:
Tony: :rocket:
